summary: Store-review fixes tested. Backend: new suite test_account_deletion_suspend.py 13/13 pass (DELETE /api/me full flow + admin suspend/unsuspend); regression backend_test.py 25 passed/3 skipped (conditional skips). Frontend (390x844 web): register via UI -> Profile -> delete-account-button -> delete-sheet -> delete-confirm-button -> toast 'Account deleted. Take care out there.' -> login screen; re-login with deleted email shows 'Invalid email or password'. /premium shows pay-with-card-button and /credits shows buy-credits-button on web (ios-credits-note absent). Demo users (8) and admin still present. Only minor code-review gaps found.

minor.issue: db.bills (creator_id/shares with the user) and db.payouts are not deleted/anonymised; bills+messages for the deleted host's party chats are left orphaned. server.py:546-570
Deleting the user's ratings does not decrement hosts' rating_sum/rating_count, so host averages keep the deleted user's stars. Reports where target_id==user remain (admin list shows target=null).
Suspended users get 403 from current_user, so they cannot delete their own account in-app (App Store 5.1.1(v) expects deletion always available). Consider allowing DELETE /me for suspended users.
Login does not check 'suspended' — returns 200 + token, then every call 403s. Better UX to return 403 'suspended' at login.

issues: delete-account-button touch target is 358x32 (<44pt height); add paddingVertical 12+
Referral card shows 'Your code …' for demo user zara (seeded users lack referral_code) — pre-existing
Spinner below plans stays visible on web (RevenueCat offerings loading) — pre-existing

action_items: Optional: in DELETE /api/me also clean db.bills / db.payouts (or anonymise), adjust host rating aggregates, and allow suspended users to delete their account
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1762 lines — should be split into routers (auth, parties, chats, admin, payments)
DELETE /me runs ~15 sequential writes without a transaction; partial failure leaves a half-deleted account (acceptable but note)
seed_data_creation: Fresh TEST_ users created and all deleted via DELETE /api/me at end. No demo/admin data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini uses xdist (-n --dist loadscope); run the new suite with -n 0. Auth rate limit 20/min per IP — sleep 60s between suites. Profile tab testID tab-profile; login testIDs login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button/toggle-auth-mode/register-name-input/register-dob-input.
